request.spec: Exports taken while a preview date is set use the preview figures.
request.prompt:

agent.result_text:
I didn't change any code: the app already does this, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in `e2e/specs/acceptance.spec.ts` as it stands.

**Why it already works:**
- All three exports (people, claims, pools) and the per-person statement export build the CSV in the browser from data the screen has already loaded. They don't call a separate export endpoint.
- Each of those loads goes through the `asOfKey(...)` helper. Once a preview date is set, that helper adds the date to the load's identity, so the data is fetched again with the `X-Preview` header and the server works the figures out as of the preview date.
- The exports take their date from `useSheetToday` (`src/main/frontend/features/sheet/sheet.ts:39`), which uses the preview date when one is set.
- Setting or clearing a preview starts a fresh load, so the data is briefly missing and each export button's `ready` check keeps it disabled until the new figures are in. An export can't pick up the old figures halfway through the switch.

In the first test, Ada's due amount is `10.00` in both exports, becomes `11.00` once the preview is set to 2026-05-01, and goes back to `10.00` when the preview is cleared. The other three scenarios pass as well.

If you expected a code change here, it may already have been made before this request.
